proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL FOR DISCLOSURE OF LOBBYING POLICIES AND PRACTICES
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing IBM's lobbying policies, direct and indirect lobbying payments including trade association and grassroots amounts, and board and management oversight of those payments.
proposals.evidence: Your Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL ON THE RIGHT TO ACT BY WRITTEN CONSENT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent.
proposals.evidence: Your Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL TO HAVE AN INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIRMAN
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, with waiver if none is available.
proposals.evidence: Your Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
